title: The Fifth-year Follow-up Study for the Phase IV Clinical Trial of Hepatitis A Vaccine in Healthy Children
brief_summary: The purpose of this follow-up study is to evaluate the five-year immune persistence of one injection of inactivated and attenuated alive hepatitis A vaccine in healthy children.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* All subjects who received inactivated or attenuated alive HAV vaccine in the previous trial

Exclusion Criteria:

* Subjects who refused to continue in the follow-up study
study_population: Healthy Chinese children aged 18 to 35 months old
